jobs.title: Assoc Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI\-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud\-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

 **Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**


The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) at ServiceNow is a customer\-focused innovation group building intelligent software and smart user experiences using existing and latest advanced technologies to enable end\-to\-end, industry\-leading work experiences for customers. We are a group of researchers, applied scientists, engineers, and product managers with a dual mission. We build and evolve the AI platform, and partner with teams to build products and end\-to\-end AI\-powered work experiences. In equal measure, we lay the foundations, research, experiment, and de\-risk AI technologies that unlock new work experiences in the future.


You will play a major part in building AI and Machine Learning (ML) solutions that transform the user experience and workflow efficiency of enterprise services. Traditional analytical tools tend to require a technically knowledgeable user to produce even simple results. We are taking a completely fresh approach with the expectation that any user, regardless of technical knowledge, can use the AI/ML solutions we develop to operate the services in the enterprise setting in an thoughtful and scalable manner. We are just getting started with our early\-adopter customers and we need your help in building and making available an amazing range of solutions to our 5k\+ enterprise customers around the world.

* Build the best cloud\-based AI/ML solutions to power intelligent enterprise services
* Collaborate daily with a team of like\-minded developers, product managers and quality engineers to produce quality software
* Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, testing and delivery of high\-quality solutions to our users

 **Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Expertise in Java or Python, OOP, Design Patterns, time and space\-efficient algorithms
* Experience building new products that use challenging algorithms
* Expertise in coding efficient, object\-oriented, modularized and quality software
* Knowledge of core AI/ML techniques and algorithms
* Knowledge of unit testing, profiling, and code tuning

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**


ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**


We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**


For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Entebbe Campus \& Hostel: Bugiri\-Bukasa, Kawuku Parish, Wakiso District, Bwerenga Road, next to Pioneer Primary School

Call/WhatsApp: \+256 757 300 379 **\+256 771 822 430**  saipali.education

Email \-info@saipali.education .com

Technical Trainer — Software Development \& AI/ML

Diploma in Software Development \& Engineering \| Full\-Time, Permanent \| Kampala, Uganda

(with full relocation support)

“Applying Knowledge”

About the Institution

The Sai Pali Institute of Technology and Management (SITM) is a premier academic institution in Kampala,

Uganda, dedicated to nurturing elite tech talent. Our ultimate goal is student transformation — producing

high\-quality software engineers ready for the global market. We are seeking an exceptionally capable and

energetic Technical Trainer from India to anchor our Diploma in Software Development and Engineering, where

you will directly shape the next generation of African tech talent.

Why Uganda? Why This Role?

* An escape from the grind, without leaving your career behind. Skip the three\-hour commutes, crowded metros,

and endless competition for the same desk job. In Kampala you will find the space — mental and physical — to actually

build things.

* Build from zero, not from a backlog. This is not a maintenance role in a 10,000\-person company. You will design

curricula, shape programmes, and leave a visible mark. Your work is the institution.

* A life upgrade, honestly priced. Low cost of living, furnished accommodation provided, and a salary that lets you

save meaningfully — increasingly rare in Indian metros.

* Africa is the next frontier. East Africa experience is rare on an Indian CV and highly valued by global companies,

ed\-tech firms, and international organisations. You will return with a story no classroom in India can give you.

* The Pearl of Africa. Uganda is stable, welcoming, English\-speaking, and stunningly beautiful — from Lake Victoria to

Bwindi's forests. Weekends here look very different from weekends in a metro.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Salary: USD 700 – 1,000 per month, based on experience (1–3 years of teaching, training, or industry

mentorship).

* Accommodation: Comfortable, furnished living accommodation provided.
* Relocation: Full relocation assistance to Kampala, including airfare and settlement support.
* Work permit \& visa: Sponsored and processed by the Institute.
* Health cover: Medical insurance provided.
* Platform: A highly collaborative, resource\-rich academic environment to build your career in.

Who Thrives Here

You are 1–3 years into your tech or teaching career, tired of being one of five hundred applicants for the same role,

and hungry for real responsibility early. You are curious, energetic, and genuinely excited by the idea of living and

working in East Africa. You may be an industry fresher with a rich project portfolio and a natural gift for instruction

— we will consider passionate candidates seriously.

Critical Eligibility Criteria

* Teaching passion: We are strictly not looking for passive slide\-readers. You must possess a profound,

infectious passion for mentoring that inspires curiosity, commands a classroom, and pushes students to excel.

* Ability to learn and teach: Technology shifts constantly. You must be able to self\-master cutting\-edge tools,

libraries, and frameworks quickly and confidently deliver them in the classroom.

Applying Knowledge

Sai Pali Institute of Technology \& Management (SITM) — Sai Pali Group

Kampala Campus: Plot \#887, Block\-4, Bakuli, Mengo, Namirembe Road, opposite Victorious Primary School, Kampala, Uganda

Entebbe Campus \& Hostel: Bugiri\-Bukasa, Kawuku Parish, Wakiso District, Bwerenga Road, next to Pioneer Primary School

Call/WhatsApp: \+256 757 300 379 **\+256 771 822 430**  saipali.education

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver hands\-on lectures: Teach core engineering principles, backend structures (Java, PHP), and advanced

AI/ML ecosystems (Python, Scikit\-Learn, TensorFlow) through 100% practical, project\-based sessions.

* Mentor capstone projects: Guide students step\-by\-step in building production\-grade software applications and

clean, well\-documented GitHub portfolios.

* Curriculum innovation: Continuously refresh learning modules to align with fast\-moving industry trends,

leveraging your ability to learn and teach new technology rapidly.

* Shape industry professionals: Evaluate students through direct code reviews, hackathons, and mock

interviews, preparing them explicitly for competitive international careers.

Required Technical Skills \& Qualifications

* Core programming: Solid coding and architectural foundations in Java and PHP.
* AI/ML expertise: Practical project experience in data preprocessing, supervised/unsupervised learning models,

and modern GenAI/LLM tools.

* Experience: 1–3 years of teaching, bootcamp training, or peer mentorship. Passionate industry freshers with

strong portfolios are welcome.

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Your Growth Path

Technical Trainer → Lead Trainer → Curriculum Head → Academic Director. Whether you stay and build SITM

into a regional powerhouse or return to India with rare international experience, this role compounds your career in

a way a conventional junior role cannot.

Life in Kampala — For You and Your Family

Kampala is a safe, established, English\-speaking city with a warm climate, a growing Indian community, and easy

weekend escapes — Lake Victoria, Jinja's Nile rapids, and Uganda's national parks. The campus is located in the

quiet Bakuli–Mengo neighbourhood, and the Institute provides secure, comfortable housing nearby.
